- `web/src/app/page.tsx` renders it with `variant="landing"`.

  - `web/src/app/tuna/page.tsx`
  - `web/src/app/communities/page.tsx`
  - `web/src/app/communities/new/page.tsx`
  - `web/src/app/user/[handle]/page.tsx`
  - `web/src/app/community/[slug]/page.tsx`
  - `web/src/app/community/[slug]/not-found.tsx`
- `web/src/app/claim/page.tsx` renders it with `variant="board"` in two places, at lines 44 and 70.
